course_identity.title: ASQ CSSGB 2022 Full-Standard Learning Program
course_identity.desired_outcome: Develop evidence-bounded capability across all 66 frozen 2022 ASQ CSSGB Body of Knowledge requirements.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded organizational scenario, distinguish plausible operational, customer, and financial value mechanisms of Six Sigma and explain the causal link without claiming observed business impact.

lesson_spec.title: Value of Six Sigma: Explain Six Sigma value mechanisms
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded organizational scenario, distinguish plausible operational, customer, and financial value mechanisms of Six Sigma and explain the causal link without claiming observed business impact.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional bounded organization scenario with stated process symptoms, customer effects, and financial constraints.
prompt_contract.required_action: Identify supported value mechanisms and explain the evidence-bounded link between the Six Sigma intervention concept and those mechanisms.
must_not_assume: causal effectiveness not present in the scenario

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies at least two value mechanisms supported by supplied scenario facts.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each named mechanism is explicitly tied to at least one stated scenario fact.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes plausible value from observed realized impact.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No unstated realized business result is asserted as fact.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Evidence needed to support a claimed value linkage is absent.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Qualify the linkage as unsupported or identify the missing evidence rather than guess.

requirement.title: Organizational goals and Six Sigma projects

criterion.outcome: Given an organizational goal and a candidate Six Sigma project outcome, determine whether the project supports the goal and state the evidence or metric linkage needed to justify the alignment.

lesson_spec.title: Organizational goals and Six Sigma projects: Evaluate goal-to-project alignment
lesson_spec.objective: Given an organizational goal and a candidate Six Sigma project outcome, determine whether the project supports the goal and state the evidence or metric linkage needed to justify the alignment.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A stated organizational goal, candidate project outcome, and a bounded set of available metrics.
prompt_contract.required_action: Explain whether and how the project outcome supports the goal and identify the metric linkage required to justify the conclusion.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response states an alignment conclusion and links it to the stated organizational goal.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The conclusion cites the supplied goal and project outcome rather than generic Six Sigma value.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies the metric or evidence needed to justify the alignment.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one relevant supplied metric is connected to the goal-outcome relationship or missing evidence is explicitly identified.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The supplied goal, outcome, or metric evidence is insufficient to justify alignment.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that alignment is not established and identify the missing linkage evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given an organizational driver and several candidate measures, identify which measure materially observes progress toward the driver and explain the relationship.

lesson_spec.title: Organizational drivers and metrics: Connect organizational drivers to metrics
lesson_spec.objective: Given an organizational driver and several candidate measures, identify which measure materially observes progress toward the driver and explain the relationship.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: One organizational driver and a bounded list of candidate measures with definitions.
prompt_contract.required_action: Select the measure that materially observes progress toward the driver and explain the relationship.
must_not_assume: causal impact of the metric itself

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response selects a candidate measure whose defined observation corresponds to the stated driver.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Selected measure is traceably relevant to the driver using the supplied definitions.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response explains why competing measures are less direct or insufficient when that distinction is supported.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Explanation uses supplied measure definitions and does not invent measurement evidence.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: No supplied measure materially observes the stated driver.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Reject the available measures as insufficient and state what measure evidence is missing.

skill.title: Classify Lean value, flow, and waste implications

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded process description, identify value-creating versus non-value-creating activity and explain how flow or waste concepts affect improvement reasoning.

lesson_spec.title: Lean concepts: Classify Lean value, flow, and waste implications
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded process description, identify value-creating versus non-value-creating activity and explain how flow or waste concepts affect improvement reasoning.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional process with explicit activities, waits, handoffs, outputs, and stated customer need.
prompt_contract.required_action: Classify evidence-supported activities or conditions using Lean value, flow, and waste concepts and identify one bounded improvement implication.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response classifies activities using the stated customer need and supplied process facts.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each classification is tied to an explicit activity or condition in the supplied process.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies an improvement implication without claiming it has already improved performance.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Improvement implication addresses an evidence-supported flow or waste condition and remains prospective.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Customer need or process facts required for a value/waste classification are absent.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark the affected classification unresolved and identify the missing process or customer evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a simplified value-stream map, identify the process-flow information it conveys and explain at least one process condition the map makes visible without inferring unavailable performance evidence.

lesson_spec.title: Value stream mapping: Interpret a bounded value-stream map
lesson_spec.objective: Given a simplified value-stream map, identify the process-flow information it conveys and explain at least one process condition the map makes visible without inferring unavailable performance evidence.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A simplified synthetic value-stream map with explicitly labeled process steps, information flow, inventory or waits, and selected stated metrics.
prompt_contract.required_action: Explain the process-flow information visible in the map and identify at least one supported process condition.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response correctly references visible map elements and their flow relationship.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Explanation names at least two map elements connected according to the supplied map.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies a process condition supported by the map and does not infer unshown performance evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Condition is traceable to a visible map feature and unsupported causal claims are absent.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A requested conclusion depends on data or relationships not shown on the map.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the map does not establish the conclusion and identify the missing evidence.

skill.title: Recognize the role of a DfSS road map

criterion.outcome: Given a design-oriented improvement scenario, explain what a DfSS road map contributes to sequencing and decision structure without asserting a specific proprietary road map not present in the frozen source evidence.

lesson_spec.title: Road maps for DfSS: Recognize the role of a DfSS road map
lesson_spec.objective: Given a design-oriented improvement scenario, explain what a DfSS road map contributes to sequencing and decision structure without asserting a specific proprietary road map not present in the frozen source evidence.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional design-oriented improvement scenario with explicit phase decisions and dependencies but no named proprietary DfSS method.
prompt_contract.required_action: Explain the sequencing and decision-structure role a DfSS road map would provide in the scenario.
must_not_assume: source details beyond the frozen requirement

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response explains a sequencing role for a DfSS road map tied to the supplied design scenario.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Explanation connects stated scenario decisions to an ordered decision structure without naming an unsupported proprietary road map.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes structural guidance from evidence that the design outcome succeeded.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No unobserved design-performance result is asserted.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The question requires a specific proprietary DfSS road-map step not supplied or frozen in the source evidence.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Decline to infer the proprietary step and state the additional source authority required.

requirement.title: Basic failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA)

skill.title: Analyze a basic failure mode and effect

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded design or process example, identify a failure mode and its effect and explain the risk-analysis reasoning needed before an improvement response is selected.

lesson_spec.title: Basic failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA): Analyze a basic failure mode and effect
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded design or process example, identify a failure mode and its effect and explain the risk-analysis reasoning needed before an improvement response is selected.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic bounded design or process example with explicit function, failure observation, effect evidence, and limited risk context.
prompt_contract.required_action: Identify the supported failure mode and effect and analyze what risk evidence is needed before selecting an improvement response.
must_not_assume: severity, occurrence, or detection ratings not supplied

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes the failure mode from its effect using the supplied example.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Failure mode and effect are separately identified and each is traceable to scenario evidence.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies risk-analysis evidence needed before selecting an improvement response.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one relevant missing or supplied risk factor is identified without inventing ratings or causes.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Risk prioritization or action selection requires severity, occurrence, detection, cause, or other evidence not supplied.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that prioritization or selection is unsupported and identify the missing evidence.

skill.title: Select Design FMEA versus Process FMEA context

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded problem context, distinguish whether Design FMEA or Process FMEA is the appropriate analysis context and explain the basis for the selection.

lesson_spec.title: Design FMEA and process FMEA: Select Design FMEA versus Process FMEA context
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded problem context, distinguish whether Design FMEA or Process FMEA is the appropriate analysis context and explain the basis for the selection.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic problem context stating whether the concern arises in product/design definition or process execution, with bounded supporting facts.
prompt_contract.required_action: Select Design FMEA or Process FMEA and explain the selection using only the supplied context.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response selects the FMEA context consistent with whether the supplied concern is design- or process-centered.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Selection matches the explicit problem locus in the scenario.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response explains the basis for the selection without asserting an unperformed FMEA result.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Explanation cites supplied context facts and contains no fabricated analysis outcome.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The scenario does not establish whether the problem concerns design definition or process execution.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the FMEA context cannot be selected reliably and identify the missing context evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded improvement scenario and stated selection considerations, evaluate whether a candidate project is an appropriate selection and state what evidence is still needed without claiming observed project success.

lesson_spec.title: Project selection: Evaluate project-selection fit
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded improvement scenario and stated selection considerations, evaluate whether a candidate project is an appropriate selection and state what evidence is still needed without claiming observed project success.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional improvement scenario with stated problem, candidate project, constraints, expected scope, and known selection considerations.
prompt_contract.required_action: Explain whether the candidate project fits the stated selection considerations and identify any evidence still needed before selection can be justified.
must_not_assume: benefits not present in the scenario

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response gives a project-selection fit conclusion tied to supplied selection considerations.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The conclusion cites at least two explicit scenario facts or considerations rather than generic project-selection advice.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes current evidence from evidence still required.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one missing or sufficient evidence condition is stated without claiming unobserved project success.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The supplied selection considerations do not support a defensible fit conclusion.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that selection fit is not established and identify the missing selection evidence rather than guess.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded process description, identify the process elements needed to reason about the process boundary and relationships without inferring unavailable performance evidence.

lesson_spec.title: Process elements: Identify process elements
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded process description, identify the process elements needed to reason about the process boundary and relationships without inferring unavailable performance evidence.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A bounded fictional process description containing explicit activities, actors, inputs, outputs, handoffs, and boundary cues.
prompt_contract.required_action: Analyze the description to identify the process elements necessary to represent its boundary and relationships.
must_not_assume: causes not evidenced by the process description

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies process elements traceable to supplied process facts.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each required element is tied to an explicit activity, actor, input, output, handoff, or boundary cue in the supplied description.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response analyzes boundary or relationship implications without inventing performance evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one relationship or boundary conclusion is supported by supplied facts and no unavailable performance value is asserted.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A requested process element or relationship cannot be determined from the supplied process description.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark that element or relationship unresolved and identify the missing process evidence.

skill.title: Interpret benchmarking purpose and comparison basis

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded benchmarking scenario, identify the intended comparison basis and explain what the comparison can and cannot support without treating a benchmark as proof of local effectiveness.

lesson_spec.title: Benchmarking: Interpret benchmarking purpose and comparison basis
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded benchmarking scenario, identify the intended comparison basis and explain what the comparison can and cannot support without treating a benchmark as proof of local effectiveness.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional benchmarking scenario with a defined local process, comparison reference, selected measures, and stated contextual differences.
prompt_contract.required_action: Explain the intended comparison basis and what conclusions the supplied benchmark can and cannot support.
must_not_assume: local effectiveness from benchmark performance alone

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies the comparison basis using the supplied process, reference, and measures.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The benchmark basis is stated in terms of explicit scenario evidence rather than an invented comparison criterion.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response states a valid evidence boundary for the benchmark.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one supported conclusion and one unsupported or conditional conclusion are distinguished without claiming local effectiveness.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The supplied benchmark lacks a comparable measure or sufficient context for the requested conclusion.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the comparison is insufficient for that conclusion and identify the missing comparison evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded process scenario, construct or inspect the supplier-input-process-output-customer relationships needed to explain the process boundary and identify an inconsistency in those relationships.

lesson_spec.title: Process inputs and outputs (SIPOC): Analyze SIPOC relationships
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded process scenario, construct or inspect the supplier-input-process-output-customer relationships needed to explain the process boundary and identify an inconsistency in those relationships.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic process scenario and partially completed SIPOC representation containing explicit suppliers, inputs, process steps, outputs, and customers.
prompt_contract.required_action: Analyze the SIPOC relationships, explain the process boundary, and identify any evidence-supported inconsistency.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response traces supplier-input-process-output-customer relationships using supplied evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The analysis correctly connects at least one complete supplier-to-customer chain supported by the scenario.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies an inconsistency or explicitly concludes none is evidenced.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The conclusion is traceable to supplied SIPOC facts and does not rely on an unstated dependency or process assumption.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The supplied scenario lacks evidence needed to complete or verify a SIPOC relationship.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Leave that relationship unresolved and identify the missing supplier, input, process, output, or customer evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded process or project scenario, distinguish process-owner and stakeholder roles and explain the decision or information relationship relevant to the improvement work.

lesson_spec.title: Owners and stakeholders: Map process owners and stakeholders
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded process or project scenario, distinguish process-owner and stakeholder roles and explain the decision or information relationship relevant to the improvement work.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional improvement project with named roles, stated decision rights, process responsibilities, interests, and information needs.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply the owner/stakeholder distinction to the supplied roles and explain the decision or information relationship relevant to the project.
must_not_assume: authority not stated in the scenario

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response assigns owner and stakeholder roles using supplied responsibilities and decision rights.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each classification is supported by an explicit scenario responsibility, authority, interest, or information need.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response explains a relevant decision or information relationship.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one relationship is tied to supplied project facts without inventing organizational authority.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A role lacks enough stated responsibility, authority, interest, or information need for classification.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark the role classification unresolved and identify the missing role evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded process or improvement scenario, identify the customer groups relevant to the stated output and distinguish known customers from assumptions that still require evidence.

lesson_spec.title: Customer identification: Identify relevant customers
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded process or improvement scenario, identify the customer groups relevant to the stated output and distinguish known customers from assumptions that still require evidence.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional process with stated outputs, recipients, users, and downstream interactions.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply customer-identification reasoning to classify the customer groups relevant to each stated output and distinguish evidenced customers from assumptions.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies customer groups traceable to stated outputs or recipients.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each identified customer group is supported by explicit scenario evidence.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response separates known customers from uncertain candidates.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Unstated or ambiguous customer identities are marked unresolved rather than asserted.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The output or recipient evidence is insufficient to determine a customer group.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark the customer identity unresolved and state what recipient or use evidence is missing.

criterion.outcome: Given bounded customer data and its collection context, identify what the data supports, surface quality or coverage limitations, and avoid treating unobserved customer outcomes as established.

lesson_spec.title: Customer data: Interpret customer data
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded customer data and its collection context, identify what the data supports, surface quality or coverage limitations, and avoid treating unobserved customer outcomes as established.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A bounded synthetic customer-data summary with collection method, sample coverage, response categories, and stated limitations.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply the supplied customer data to state supported findings and identify quality or coverage limitations.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response states findings supported by supplied customer data.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each finding is traceable to an explicit value, category, or collection fact.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies at least one material data limitation when present.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The limitation is tied to supplied collection or coverage evidence and unsupported population claims are absent.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The supplied customer data cannot support the requested conclusion.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the conclusion is not established and identify the missing or inadequate data evidence.

skill.title: Translate customer needs into explicit requirements

criterion.outcome: Given bounded customer statements and process context, express explicit customer requirements and distinguish directly supported requirements from inferred or unresolved needs.

lesson_spec.title: Customer requirements: Translate customer needs into explicit requirements
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded customer statements and process context, express explicit customer requirements and distinguish directly supported requirements from inferred or unresolved needs.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic set of customer statements plus bounded process context and explicitly defined terms.
prompt_contract.required_action: Translate supported customer statements into explicit requirements and label inferred or unresolved needs separately.
must_not_assume: technical specifications not supported by statements

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response produces explicit requirements traceable to customer statements.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each supported requirement references a supplied statement or process fact.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes direct requirements from inference.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Any unsupported need is labeled inferred or unresolved rather than presented as customer fact.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A customer statement is too ambiguous to produce an explicit requirement.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Preserve the need as unresolved and identify what clarification or evidence is needed.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded improvement project and an explicitly stated methodology, identify the appropriate current phase or step and the evidence needed to advance without claiming project success.

lesson_spec.title: Project methodology: Apply the stated project methodology
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded improvement project and an explicitly stated methodology, identify the appropriate current phase or step and the evidence needed to advance without claiming project success.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional improvement project, an explicitly named project methodology, current artifacts, and phase-entry evidence.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply the stated methodology to identify the current phase or step and the evidence required to advance.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response selects a phase or step consistent with the supplied methodology and project evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The selected phase or step is justified by explicit current artifacts or entry evidence.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies evidence needed for advancement.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Required evidence is stated without marking unobserved gates complete.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The current project evidence does not establish a unique methodology phase or advancement condition.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State the ambiguity and identify the missing phase-entry or completion evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded project charter, identify missing, inconsistent, or unsupported elements needed for a coherent project definition while preserving unresolved business or sponsor decisions as unresolved.

lesson_spec.title: Project charter: Analyze project-charter completeness and consistency
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded project charter, identify missing, inconsistent, or unsupported elements needed for a coherent project definition while preserving unresolved business or sponsor decisions as unresolved.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic project charter containing stated problem, objective, scope, stakeholders, measures, assumptions, and selected omissions or inconsistencies.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply charter-review criteria to identify missing, inconsistent, or unsupported elements needed for coherent project definition.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies charter defects supported by the supplied artifact.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each identified omission, inconsistency, or unsupported element is traceable to charter content or absence.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response preserves sponsor or business decisions as unresolved when not supplied.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No missing approval or decision is invented as fact.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A charter judgment depends on business or sponsor information not included in the artifact.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark that judgment unresolved and identify the missing decision or evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded improvement scenario and stated project intent, distinguish in-scope from out-of-scope work and identify boundary assumptions or interfaces that still require sponsor or business confirmation.

lesson_spec.title: Project scope: Define project-scope boundaries
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded improvement scenario and stated project intent, distinguish in-scope from out-of-scope work and identify boundary assumptions or interfaces that still require sponsor or business confirmation.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional project intent, process boundary, candidate activities, interfaces, and stated constraints.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply scope reasoning to classify supplied work as in scope, out of scope, or unresolved and identify boundary assumptions requiring confirmation.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response classifies scope items using supplied project intent and boundary evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each classification is tied to explicit scenario facts.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response surfaces unresolved boundary assumptions or interfaces.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Missing sponsor or business decisions are left unresolved rather than invented.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A candidate activity or interface lacks enough evidence for a scope classification.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark it unresolved and state which project-boundary evidence or decision is missing.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded project objective and candidate measures, identify metrics that meaningfully observe the stated project objective and distinguish supported measures from assumptions that still require evidence.

lesson_spec.title: Project metrics: Select project metrics
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded project objective and candidate measures, identify metrics that meaningfully observe the stated project objective and distinguish supported measures from assumptions that still require evidence.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A stated project objective and a bounded set of candidate measures with definitions and collection context.
prompt_contract.required_action: Select metrics that meaningfully observe the objective and explain why other measures are insufficient or unresolved.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response selects metrics traceably connected to the stated objective.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each selected metric is justified using its supplied definition and the project objective.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes supported metrics from unresolved or irrelevant measures.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Unsupported measures are rejected or qualified without inventing measurement evidence.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: No supplied measure adequately observes the stated objective.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that metric selection is unresolved and identify the missing measurement evidence.

skill.title: Select a project-planning tool for a bounded need

criterion.outcome: Given a stated project-planning need, select an appropriate planning-tool class and explain what information or decision the tool is intended to support without treating a tool choice as evidence of project success.

lesson_spec.title: Project planning tools: Select a project-planning tool for a bounded need
lesson_spec.objective: Given a stated project-planning need, select an appropriate planning-tool class and explain what information or decision the tool is intended to support without treating a tool choice as evidence of project success.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A bounded project-planning need, available information, coordination constraints, and candidate tool classes.
prompt_contract.required_action: Select an appropriate planning-tool class and explain the planning information or decision it supports.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response selects a tool class aligned with the stated planning need.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Selection is justified by explicit planning information, coordination, or decision requirements.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response states the bounded function of the selected tool.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The explanation does not treat tool selection as evidence of project outcome.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The planning need or available information is too ambiguous to choose a tool class.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State the ambiguity and identify the missing planning requirement rather than guess.

criterion.outcome: Given bounded project records, identify missing, inconsistent, or stale documentation needed to preserve traceability of project decisions, evidence, scope, and status without fabricating unobserved approvals or outcomes.

lesson_spec.title: Project documentation: Maintain coherent project documentation
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded project records, identify missing, inconsistent, or stale documentation needed to preserve traceability of project decisions, evidence, scope, and status without fabricating unobserved approvals or outcomes.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic set of project records with timestamps, decisions, scope statements, status entries, evidence references, and selected omissions or conflicts.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply documentation-integrity checks to identify missing, inconsistent, or stale records that affect traceability.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies traceability defects supported by the supplied records.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each defect references an explicit omission, conflict, timestamp, or stale status condition.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response preserves unknown approvals or outcomes as unknown.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No missing approval or outcome is fabricated to repair the record.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The records do not establish whether an item is current, approved, or authoritative.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Flag the status as unresolved and identify the missing record or authority evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded project scenario, identify material project risks, distinguish supported risk evidence from assumptions, and describe a proportionate mitigation or monitoring response without claiming the risk has been eliminated.

lesson_spec.title: Project risk analysis and management: Analyze and manage project risk
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded project scenario, identify material project risks, distinguish supported risk evidence from assumptions, and describe a proportionate mitigation or monitoring response without claiming the risk has been eliminated.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional project scenario with explicit uncertainties, dependencies, constraints, likelihood or impact cues, and available controls.
prompt_contract.required_action: Explain the material risks supported by the scenario and a proportionate mitigation or monitoring response.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies material risks traceable to supplied scenario evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each named risk is linked to an explicit uncertainty, dependency, constraint, likelihood cue, or impact cue.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response proposes a proportionate mitigation or monitoring response without claiming elimination.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The response distinguishes planned risk treatment from observed post-treatment outcome.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The scenario lacks evidence needed to characterize a proposed risk or its priority.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Qualify the risk characterization and identify the missing evidence rather than assign an unsupported rating.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded project record and stated completion criteria, identify which closure conditions are supported, which evidence is missing, and which approvals or outcomes remain unobserved.

lesson_spec.title: Project closure: Evaluate project-closure readiness
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded project record and stated completion criteria, identify which closure conditions are supported, which evidence is missing, and which approvals or outcomes remain unobserved.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic project record with explicit completion criteria, evidence entries, approvals, deliverables, and selected omissions.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply the stated closure criteria to classify conditions as evidenced, missing, or unresolved.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response classifies closure conditions from supplied criteria and records.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each closure classification is tied to explicit project evidence or a documented absence.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response preserves approvals and outcomes not present in evidence as unobserved.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No missing approval, benefit, or acceptance outcome is fabricated.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A closure criterion lacks enough evidence for a pass or fail determination.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark the criterion unresolved and identify the missing evidence or approval.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded management or planning need, select an appropriate tool class and explain the information, coordination, or decision function it is intended to support without claiming the tool guarantees an outcome.

lesson_spec.title: Management and planning tools: Select management and planning tools
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded management or planning need, select an appropriate tool class and explain the information, coordination, or decision function it is intended to support without claiming the tool guarantees an outcome.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A bounded management or planning need, available information, coordination constraints, and candidate tool classes.
prompt_contract.required_action: Select a tool class suited to the supplied need and explain its information, coordination, or decision function.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response selects a tool class aligned with supplied management or planning needs.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The selection cites explicit information, coordination, or decision requirements.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response bounds the function of the selected tool.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The tool is not presented as proof or guarantee of an outcome.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The management or planning need is insufficiently specified for tool selection.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State the selection is unresolved and identify the missing planning requirement.

criterion.outcome: Given bounded process-performance measures and their context, interpret what the measures support, identify limitations or missing baselines, and avoid converting descriptive evidence into unsupported effectiveness claims.

lesson_spec.title: Process performance metrics: Analyze process-performance metrics
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded process-performance measures and their context, interpret what the measures support, identify limitations or missing baselines, and avoid converting descriptive evidence into unsupported effectiveness claims.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: Synthetic process-performance measures with definitions, periods, denominators, and stated comparison context.
prompt_contract.required_action: Analyze what the measures support, identify material limitations or missing baselines, and distinguish description from effectiveness claims.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response interprets measures using supplied definitions and context.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each interpretation is traceable to an explicit metric value, period, denominator, or comparison fact.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies limitations or missing baseline evidence where applicable.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Unsupported effectiveness or causal conclusions are absent.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The measures lack sufficient baseline, definition, or comparison context for the requested inference.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the inference is not established and identify the missing metric evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded improvement context, identify the audience, purpose, evidence, and feedback needs for an organizational communication and distinguish confirmed facts from unresolved decisions or assumptions.

lesson_spec.title: Organizational communication: Plan organizational communication
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded improvement context, identify the audience, purpose, evidence, and feedback needs for an organizational communication and distinguish confirmed facts from unresolved decisions or assumptions.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional improvement context with named audiences, communication purpose, confirmed evidence, unresolved decisions, channels, and feedback needs.
prompt_contract.required_action: Construct a bounded communication plan identifying audience, purpose, evidence, channel or timing considerations, and feedback path while labeling unresolved decisions.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response maps audience, purpose, and evidence using supplied context.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The plan includes traceable audience and evidence choices rather than generic communication advice.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response includes a feedback path and separates confirmed facts from unresolved decisions.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Unresolved items remain explicitly unresolved and no acceptance outcome is asserted.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The audience, purpose, or evidence needed for a communication decision is not supplied.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark that part of the plan unresolved and identify the missing communication evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded team scenario, identify observable team-stage or interaction characteristics and describe an appropriate coordination response without asserting unobserved motives or team effectiveness.

lesson_spec.title: Team stages and dynamics: Recognize team stages and dynamics
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded team scenario, identify observable team-stage or interaction characteristics and describe an appropriate coordination response without asserting unobserved motives or team effectiveness.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional team interaction with observable behaviors, coordination events, conflicts, decisions, and stated context.
prompt_contract.required_action: Explain the observable team-stage or interaction characteristics and an appropriate coordination response supported by the scenario.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies team-stage or interaction characteristics from observable scenario evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each characteristic is tied to an explicit behavior, event, conflict, or coordination fact.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response describes a coordination response without asserting hidden motives or outcomes.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The response is proportionate to observed conditions and avoids unobserved effectiveness claims.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Observable team evidence is insufficient to characterize a stage or dynamic.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the characterization is uncertain and identify the missing observable evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded team scenario, distinguish stated roles from responsibilities, identify ownership or coordination gaps, and keep unresolved authority or accountability decisions explicit.

lesson_spec.title: Team roles and responsibilities: Map team roles and responsibilities
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded team scenario, distinguish stated roles from responsibilities, identify ownership or coordination gaps, and keep unresolved authority or accountability decisions explicit.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional team scenario with named roles, stated responsibilities, decision rights, handoffs, and selected gaps.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply role/responsibility mapping to identify ownership and coordination gaps while preserving unstated authority decisions as unresolved.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response maps roles and responsibilities using supplied evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each mapping cites an explicit role, responsibility, decision right, or handoff.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies gaps without inventing authority or accountability.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Unstated ownership or accountability is marked unresolved rather than assigned.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A role lacks sufficient stated responsibility or authority for a mapping decision.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark the mapping unresolved and identify the missing responsibility or authority evidence.

skill.title: Select team tools and decision-making concepts

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded team decision need, select an appropriate team-tool or decision-making concept and explain the decision function it supports without treating tool use as proof of decision quality.

lesson_spec.title: Team tools and decision-making concepts: Select team tools and decision-making concepts
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded team decision need, select an appropriate team-tool or decision-making concept and explain the decision function it supports without treating tool use as proof of decision quality.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A bounded team decision need, available evidence, participation constraints, and candidate team-tool or decision-concept classes.
prompt_contract.required_action: Select an appropriate tool or decision-making concept and explain the decision function it supports.
must_not_assume: decision quality from tool use alone

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response selects a team tool or decision concept aligned with the supplied decision need.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Selection is justified by explicit decision, evidence, or participation requirements.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response bounds what the selected tool can establish.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Tool use is not treated as proof of decision quality, consensus, or effectiveness.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The team decision need or constraints are insufficiently specified for tool selection.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that selection is unresolved and identify the missing decision evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded team interaction, identify the communication purpose, audience, evidence, feedback path, and unresolved assumptions needed for clear coordination without asserting unobserved team effectiveness.

lesson_spec.title: Team communication: Plan and evaluate team communication
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded team interaction, identify the communication purpose, audience, evidence, feedback path, and unresolved assumptions needed for clear coordination without asserting unobserved team effectiveness.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional team interaction with purpose, audience, confirmed facts, unresolved assumptions, coordination constraints, and available feedback paths.
prompt_contract.required_action: Construct a bounded communication response that addresses purpose, audience, evidence, feedback path, and unresolved assumptions.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response addresses communication purpose, audience, and evidence using supplied facts.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The communication choices are traceable to explicit interaction evidence.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response includes a feedback path and keeps assumptions explicit.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Unresolved assumptions are labeled and no acceptance or effectiveness outcome is asserted.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The interaction lacks sufficient audience, purpose, evidence, or feedback information for a communication decision.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark that element unresolved and identify the missing communication evidence.

skill.title: Create a bounded process analysis and documentation representation

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded process scenario and available evidence, create a coherent process representation that distinguishes observed process steps, inputs, outputs, decision points, assumptions, and missing evidence without fabricating operational facts.

lesson_spec.title: Process analysis and documentation: Create a bounded process analysis and documentation representation
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded process scenario and available evidence, create a coherent process representation that distinguishes observed process steps, inputs, outputs, decision points, assumptions, and missing evidence without fabricating operational facts.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional process scenario with explicit steps, inputs, outputs, decision cues, actors, assumptions, and intentional evidence gaps.
prompt_contract.required_action: Create a coherent process representation that separates observed process facts, assumptions, decisions, interfaces, and missing evidence.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Created representation contains process steps, inputs, outputs, and decision points traceable to supplied evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Every represented process fact can be mapped to an explicit scenario fact.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Created representation distinguishes assumptions and missing evidence from observed facts.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Evidence gaps and assumptions are explicitly marked rather than converted into process facts.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A requested process element cannot be established from supplied evidence.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Represent that element as unknown or unresolved and identify the missing operational evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded uncertain event or simple probability scenario, identify the relevant probability concepts and interpret the resulting probability statement without extending it beyond the stated assumptions.

lesson_spec.title: Basic probability concepts: Reason with basic probability concepts
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded uncertain event or simple probability scenario, identify the relevant probability concepts and interpret the resulting probability statement without extending it beyond the stated assumptions.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic uncertain event with explicitly stated outcomes, counts or probabilities, and assumptions.
prompt_contract.required_action: Explain the relevant probability concept and interpret the supplied or derivable probability statement within its stated assumptions.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies a probability concept consistent with supplied event structure.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The concept is linked to explicit outcomes, counts, probabilities, or stated assumptions.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response interprets the probability without extending beyond assumptions.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No unsupported independence, causal, or population claim is made.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The event structure or required probability inputs are missing.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the probability conclusion is not established and identify the missing event or probability evidence.

skill.title: Interpret the central limit theorem in a bounded sampling context

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded sampling context and stated assumptions, explain what the central limit theorem supports about a sampling distribution and identify conditions or limitations that prevent stronger claims.

lesson_spec.title: Central limit theorem: Interpret the central limit theorem in a bounded sampling context
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded sampling context and stated assumptions, explain what the central limit theorem supports about a sampling distribution and identify conditions or limitations that prevent stronger claims.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic sampling context with sample size, sampling process, population description where known, and explicitly stated assumptions.
prompt_contract.required_action: Explain what the central limit theorem supports for the sampling distribution and identify limitations on that conclusion.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response explains a CLT implication tied to supplied sampling conditions.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The implication references explicit sample-size or sampling-context evidence.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies conditions limiting stronger inference.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one material assumption or limitation is stated when applicable and unsupported population claims are absent.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The sampling context lacks conditions needed for the requested CLT conclusion.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the conclusion is conditional or unsupported and identify the missing sampling evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded statistical scenario or distribution description, identify relevant distribution characteristics and distinguish what the stated distribution assumptions do and do not support.

lesson_spec.title: Statistical distributions: Recognize statistical-distribution characteristics
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded statistical scenario or distribution description, identify relevant distribution characteristics and distinguish what the stated distribution assumptions do and do not support.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic distribution description or bounded statistical summary with explicitly stated shape, support, parameter, or process cues.
prompt_contract.required_action: Classify relevant distribution characteristics and explain what the stated assumptions support and do not support.
must_not_assume: a named distribution without sufficient cues

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response classifies distribution characteristics from supplied evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each classification is tied to an explicit shape, support, parameter, or process cue.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes supported distribution assumptions from unsupported ones.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No distribution fit or parameter claim is invented.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The supplied distribution evidence is insufficient for a requested classification.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the classification is unresolved and identify the missing distribution evidence.

requirement.title: Types of data and measurement scales

skill.title: Classify data types and measurement scales

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded set of variables or measurements, classify their data types and measurement scales and explain how the classification constrains valid interpretation or analysis choices.

lesson_spec.title: Types of data and measurement scales: Classify data types and measurement scales
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded set of variables or measurements, classify their data types and measurement scales and explain how the classification constrains valid interpretation or analysis choices.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic set of variables or measurements with values, labels, units, ordering information, and collection context.
prompt_contract.required_action: Analyze each variable to classify its data type and measurement scale and explain one analysis or interpretation constraint created by that classification.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response classifies data type and measurement scale using supplied variable properties.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Each classification cites explicit values, units, labels, or ordering evidence.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response connects classification to a valid interpretation or analysis constraint.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The stated constraint follows from the classified scale without asserting unsupported method validity.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: A variable lacks enough measurement information for a unique scale classification.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Mark the classification unresolved and identify the missing measurement property.

requirement.title: Sampling and data collection plans and methods

skill.title: Construct a bounded sampling and data-collection plan

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded measurement objective and operating context, select a sampling and data-collection approach, state the population or process boundary, identify collection controls and limitations, and distinguish planned evidence from observations not yet collected.

lesson_spec.title: Sampling and data collection plans and methods: Construct a bounded sampling and data-collection plan
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded measurement objective and operating context, select a sampling and data-collection approach, state the population or process boundary, identify collection controls and limitations, and distinguish planned evidence from observations not yet collected.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A fictional measurement objective with process boundary, access constraints, candidate sampling methods, collection conditions, and known limitations.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply sampling and data-collection planning to select an approach, state the boundary, identify collection controls, and label evidence that remains uncollected.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response selects a sampling/data-collection approach tied to the supplied measurement objective and operating context.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Selection cites explicit boundary, access, method, or collection facts.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies controls or limitations and distinguishes planned from observed evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one material control or limitation is stated and uncollected observations are not presented as facts.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The supplied context is insufficient to select or bound a sampling approach.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the plan is unresolved and identify the missing population, process, access, or collection evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded dataset and stated measurement context, compute or interpret appropriate descriptive summaries, identify distortion or coverage limits, and avoid extending descriptive results into unsupported causal or population claims.

lesson_spec.title: Descriptive statistics: Evaluate descriptive statistics
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded dataset and stated measurement context, compute or interpret appropriate descriptive summaries, identify distortion or coverage limits, and avoid extending descriptive results into unsupported causal or population claims.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic dataset or descriptive summary with measurement context, sample coverage, and known collection limitations.
prompt_contract.required_action: Evaluate the descriptive summaries for the stated question, identify distortion or coverage limits, and state what conclusions are and are not supported.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response evaluates descriptive summaries using explicit dataset values or supplied summary statistics.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The evaluation references at least two supplied numerical or coverage facts.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies distortion or coverage limits and bounds inference.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one material limitation is stated when present and no unsupported causal or population claim is made.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The data or summary lacks the values, context, or coverage needed for the requested evaluation.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the evaluation is limited and identify the missing descriptive or collection evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given bounded data and an explicit analytical question, select and construct an appropriate graphical method, state what pattern the display supports, and identify misleading or unsupported interpretations.

lesson_spec.title: Graphical methods: Construct an appropriate graphical representation
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded data and an explicit analytical question, select and construct an appropriate graphical method, state what pattern the display supports, and identify misleading or unsupported interpretations.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic bounded dataset plus an explicit analytical question and variable definitions.
prompt_contract.required_action: Create an appropriate graphical representation specification, state the supported pattern, and identify at least one misleading or unsupported interpretation to avoid.
must_not_assume: patterns not visible in the supplied data

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response constructs a graph specification appropriate to the supplied variables and analytical question.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Graph type, axes or grouping, and represented variables are explicitly defined and compatible with the supplied data.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes supported visual interpretation from misleading or unsupported interpretation.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: At least one supported pattern and one prohibited overinterpretation are stated using the supplied data context.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The data types or analytical question are insufficient to select a defensible graphical method.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that graph selection is unresolved and identify the missing variable or analytical evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given bounded measurement-system evidence and stated use requirements, evaluate whether observed measurement variation or bias is material to the intended decision and identify evidence still required before stronger suitability claims.

lesson_spec.title: Measurement system analysis (MSA): Evaluate a measurement system
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded measurement-system evidence and stated use requirements, evaluate whether observed measurement variation or bias is material to the intended decision and identify evidence still required before stronger suitability claims.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: Synthetic measurement-system results with stated intended use, observed variation or bias indicators, decision tolerances, and known study limits.
prompt_contract.required_action: Evaluate whether the observed measurement-system evidence is material to the intended decision and identify any evidence needed before a stronger suitability claim.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response evaluates measurement variation or bias against the stated use or decision context.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The judgment references explicit study values, limits, or decision requirements.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies remaining evidence needed for stronger suitability claims.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Any missing stability, scope, repeatability, reproducibility, or acceptance evidence remains explicitly unobserved.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The study results or intended-use criteria are insufficient for a suitability judgment.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that suitability is not established and identify the missing measurement-system or use evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given bounded process-performance evidence and explicit specification limits, compare observed performance with the specification basis and distinguish descriptive conformance evidence from unobserved future capability or effectiveness.

lesson_spec.title: Process performance vs. process specifications: Compare process performance with specifications
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded process-performance evidence and explicit specification limits, compare observed performance with the specification basis and distinguish descriptive conformance evidence from unobserved future capability or effectiveness.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: Synthetic process-performance evidence with explicit specification limits, observation period, and measurement context.
prompt_contract.required_action: Evaluate observed performance against the specification basis and distinguish current descriptive conformance evidence from future capability or effectiveness claims.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response compares supplied performance evidence with explicit specification limits.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The comparison references the stated limits and observed values or summaries.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response separates observed conformance from future capability or effectiveness.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No future capability, stability, or effectiveness claim is made without evidence.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Specification limits or observed performance evidence are insufficient for the requested comparison.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the comparison cannot be completed and identify the missing specification or performance evidence.

criterion.outcome: Given bounded process data, specification context, and stated capability-study conditions, evaluate what the study supports, identify assumption or stability limitations, and distinguish observed study results from unobserved future performance.

lesson_spec.title: Process capability studies: Evaluate a process capability study
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded process data, specification context, and stated capability-study conditions, evaluate what the study supports, identify assumption or stability limitations, and distinguish observed study results from unobserved future performance.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: Synthetic process data and capability-study output with specification context, study conditions, stability evidence where available, and stated assumptions.
prompt_contract.required_action: Evaluate what the capability study supports, identify assumption or stability limitations, and distinguish observed study results from future process performance.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response evaluates the capability-study result using supplied data, specifications, and study conditions.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The judgment cites explicit study or specification evidence rather than a generic capability rule.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies assumption or stability limitations and bounds future inference.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Missing stability or condition evidence is stated and no future-performance claim is fabricated.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Study conditions, specification context, or stability evidence are insufficient for the requested capability judgment.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State that the judgment is limited or unresolved and identify the missing capability-study evidence.

skill.title: Interpret process capability and performance indices

criterion.outcome: Given bounded specification limits, process summaries, and stated index assumptions, calculate or interpret capability/performance indices and explain what each index can and cannot support about the process.

lesson_spec.title: Process capability and performance indices: Interpret process capability and performance indices
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded specification limits, process summaries, and stated index assumptions, calculate or interpret capability/performance indices and explain what each index can and cannot support about the process.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: Synthetic specification limits, process summaries, stated capability/performance indices or sufficient values for calculation, and explicit assumptions.
prompt_contract.required_action: Analyze or calculate the relevant indices, interpret them against the supplied specification context, and state what the indices can and cannot establish.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response computes or checks index values consistently with supplied inputs or interprets supplied indices correctly.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Numeric or interpretive conclusions are traceable to explicit limits, summaries, and stated assumptions.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes index interpretation from unsupported process claims.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The response does not treat an index alone as proof of stability, causality, or future effectiveness.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Required limits, process summaries, or index assumptions are absent or inconsistent.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Do not calculate or overinterpret the index; identify the missing or conflicting evidence.

requirement.title: Short-term vs. long-term capability and sigma shift

skill.title: Compare short- and long-term capability and sigma-shift assumptions

criterion.outcome: Given bounded short- and long-term process summaries and explicit assumptions, compare capability interpretations, identify where sigma-shift assumptions enter the reasoning, and avoid treating a conventional shift value as universally observed evidence.

lesson_spec.title: Short-term vs. long-term capability and sigma shift: Compare short- and long-term capability and sigma-shift assumptions
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded short- and long-term process summaries and explicit assumptions, compare capability interpretations, identify where sigma-shift assumptions enter the reasoning, and avoid treating a conventional shift value as universally observed evidence.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: Synthetic short- and long-term process summaries with explicit capability assumptions and any sigma-shift value identified as an assumption rather than an observation unless directly measured.
prompt_contract.required_action: Evaluate the short- versus long-term capability interpretations and identify exactly where any sigma-shift assumption affects the reasoning.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response compares short- and long-term capability using supplied summaries and explicit assumptions.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The comparison references supplied process summaries and clearly separates the two time horizons.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response identifies sigma-shift assumptions explicitly and does not universalize them.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Any shift value is labeled observed only when supplied as observed evidence; otherwise it remains an explicit assumption.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Short-term, long-term, or sigma-shift evidence is insufficient for the requested comparison.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State which part of the comparison is unresolved and identify the missing process summary or assumption evidence.

skill.title: Create a bounded multi-vari study design

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded variation problem, candidate factors, and available observations, create a multi-vari study representation that distinguishes positional, cyclical, and temporal variation where supported and keeps unobserved causes explicit rather than inferred.

lesson_spec.title: Multi-vari studies: Create a bounded multi-vari study design
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded variation problem, candidate factors, and available observations, create a multi-vari study representation that distinguishes positional, cyclical, and temporal variation where supported and keeps unobserved causes explicit rather than inferred.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic bounded variation problem with candidate factors, available observations, and explicit observation limits.
prompt_contract.required_action: Create a multi-vari study representation that separates positional, cyclical, and temporal variation where supported and marks unsupported causes as unobserved.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response constructs a study representation that distinguishes the required variation dimensions using supplied evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: Positional, cyclical, and temporal elements are represented when supported and traceable to supplied observations.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response keeps unsupported causal explanations explicit as unobserved.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No candidate cause is promoted to an observed cause without supplied evidence.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: The supplied observations cannot support one or more requested variation dimensions or causal distinctions.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: Construct only the supported study elements and identify the missing evidence instead of inventing structure or causes.

skill.title: Evaluate correlation and linear regression evidence

criterion.outcome: Given bounded paired data or summarized regression output, evaluate the direction and strength of association, interpret a simple linear relationship within stated assumptions, and distinguish association from unsupported causal claims.

lesson_spec.title: Correlation and linear regression: Evaluate correlation and linear regression evidence
lesson_spec.objective: Given bounded paired data or summarized regression output, evaluate the direction and strength of association, interpret a simple linear relationship within stated assumptions, and distinguish association from unsupported causal claims.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: Synthetic paired data or regression summary with stated assumptions and bounded context.
prompt_contract.required_action: Evaluate association direction and strength, interpret the supplied linear relationship, and distinguish supported association from unsupported causality.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response evaluates direction and strength using supplied paired data or regression evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The evaluation cites explicit data or model-summary evidence and is consistent with it.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes association from causation and bounds interpretation by stated assumptions.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: No causal claim is made unless causal evidence is explicitly supplied.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Paired data, regression output, or assumptions are insufficient for the requested evaluation.
insufficient_evidence_behavior.required_behavior: State which relationship judgment is unresolved and identify the missing evidence rather than infer it.

criterion.outcome: Given a bounded statistical claim, stated null and alternative hypotheses, and decision context, apply basic hypothesis-testing logic and interpret the decision boundary without claiming evidence not present in the supplied data.

lesson_spec.title: Hypothesis testing basics: Apply basic hypothesis-testing logic
lesson_spec.objective: Given a bounded statistical claim, stated null and alternative hypotheses, and decision context, apply basic hypothesis-testing logic and interpret the decision boundary without claiming evidence not present in the supplied data.

prompt_contract.supplied_evidence: A synthetic statistical claim with explicit null and alternative hypotheses, decision threshold, and bounded result evidence.
prompt_contract.required_action: Apply basic hypothesis-testing logic to the supplied case and state the justified decision and its evidentiary limits.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response applies the stated null/alternative and decision boundary consistently to supplied evidence.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The decision follows the supplied threshold and result evidence without reversing or inventing criteria.

scoring_assertions.observable_property: Response distinguishes a statistical decision from unsupported substantive claims.
scoring_assertions.pass_condition: The response does not infer effect magnitude, causality, or practical importance from the test decision alone.

insufficient_evidence_behavior.trigger: Hypotheses, decision threshold, or result evidence needed for the decision are missing or inconsistent.
